content:
The necessary and sufficient condition is \(c_1=c_2\).

For \(n=3q+r\):
- \(r=0\): \(c_1=c_2=q\)
- \(r=1\): \(c_1=q+1,\ c_2=q\)
- \(r=2\): \(c_1=c_2=q+1\)

So we need \(n\equiv 0\) or \(2\pmod 3\). Also \(n\) must be even.

Thus count even \(n\le 2024\) with \(n\not\equiv 1\pmod 3\), i.e. \(n\equiv 0\) or \(2\pmod 6\).

Count:
\[
\left\lfloor\frac{2024}{6}\right\rfloor + \left(\left\lfloor\frac{2024-2}{6}\right\rfloor+1\right)
=337+338=675.
\]

\[
\boxed{675}
\]
